description: This file contains functions for building and managing agent graphs, including multi-agent and sequential agent workflows, with complex graph validation, node initialization, and streaming output handling.

methods.name: buildAgentGraph
methods.description: Main function to build and stream the agent graph output, handling multi-agent and sequential workflows, including error handling and SSE streaming.

methods.name: compileMultiAgentsGraph
methods.description: Constructs a graph for multiple agents, initializing nodes, setting conditional edges, and managing execution flow with callbacks and memory.

methods.name: compileSeqAgentsGraph
methods.description: Constructs a sequential agent graph with validation, conditional edges, and interruption handling, returning a stream for execution.

methods.name: getSortedDepthNodes
methods.description: Sorts nodes based on their depth queue for proper execution order in graph processing.
